'''Krova''' served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] and was Co-[[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo's]] personal [[Communications officer/Legends|communications officer]] onboard the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].
